name: Nemo Stats: Plasma Weapons
description:
Tunes the plasma weapons' projectiles, charge, and damage.

- PLAS-39 Accelerator Rifle
  Primary low stagger AP4 sniper rifle.
- PLAS-1 Scorcher
  Assault rifle, better ammo economy.
- PLAS-101 Purifier
  Assault rifle/grenade launcher hybrid.
  Shorter charge, better ammo economy.
- PLAS-15 Loyalist
  Pistol/grenade launcher hybrid.
  Auto-fires at full charge.
  Better ammo economy.
- SG-8P Punisher Plasma
  Plasma grenade launcher.
  Faster payload, bigger damage.
- PLAS-45 Epoch
  Low charge time to bombard chaff enemies.
  Better ammo economy.
  Flatter, faster trajectory.
